description:
Search the Male Confidence Index 2025 research report for passages on a topic, with page numbers.

    Returns the report's own findings and interpretation as short excerpts, plus any matching key
    figures (generational percentages read from the report's charts). Passages list survey_questions:
    pass those ids to mci_results for the full weighted answers or other cuts.

    Args:
        query: topic, e.g. "midlife confidence", "social media and Gen Z", "fatherhood", "asking for help".
        chapter: optional chapter number (1 to 7) or words from a section/chapter title, e.g. "Opportunities".
        limit: passages to return, 1 to 6 (default 4).
name: mci_report_search
title: Male Confidence Index: search the report
